narr: A cold front, combined with tropical moisture from Tropical Storm Eta produced flash flooding.
ev: A vehicle was overtaken by floodwaters at the intersection of Eugenes Rd. and Spring Branch Rd. A person and dog managed to escape the stranded vehicle.
lsr: MEDIA REPORTED A VEHICLE WAS OVERTAKEN BY FLOODWATERS AT THE INTERSECTION OF EUGENES AND SPRING BRANCH RD. IN NICHOLS, SC. A PERSON AND DOG ESCAPED THE STRANDED VEHICLE.
